segments.name: Ultrasonic Coating Systems
segments.description: Designs and manufactures custom-engineered ultrasonic coating systems that apply precise thin film coatings for microelectronics, medical, industrial, alternative energy and emerging markets.
segments.evidence: Our products include fully integrated Multi-Axis Coating Systems, Integrated Coating Systems, Fluxing Systems, OEM Systems and other related systems.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including original equipment manufacturers, distributors and end users, pay the company for ultrasonic coating equipment and application consulting services, sold through direct sales personnel, distributors and sales representatives.
revenueModel.evidence: Our principal customers include original equipment manufacturers, distributors and end users of our products in the industries that we serve.
